title: The Point Is Yours
style: afro big band jazz, female lead vocal, brass section live drums, 94 BPM, call and response, multilingual pickleball coaching anthem, uplifting choir, longer than 2 mins
lyrics:
[INTRO]
(spoken)
Every point is a fresh start.
No language needed for that.
But we'll say it anyway.

[VERSE 1 - English]
Reset your mind between each point
Shake it off, loosen every joint
Breathe in slow, breathe out clear
The next point starts right here

[VERSE 2 - Wolof transliteration]
Yokk sa xol ci kaw ci kaw xam bi
Fal ko, metti sa yaram
Suñu jem bu yomb, suñu dem bu set
Li des bi dafa tane fii

[VERSE 3 - Albanian transliteration]
Ristarto mendjen ndermjet cdo pike
Hidhe tutje, zgjidh cdo nyje
Marr fryme ngadale, nxjerr te qarte
Pika tjeter fillon ketu

[CHORUS]
POINT - PIKE - POEN - RESET
RESET - BREATHE - HOLD YOUR LINE
THE POINT IS YOURS - EVERY TIME
FRESH START - EVERY SINGLE POINT

[VERSE 4 - Burmese transliteration]
Tat pyit kyauk mha sate sit lo pyan pyaw
Nway so, kat kyet ma htite
Lat tat kya, lat htwet san
Naut lin amyit di hma si lo pyaw

[VERSE 5 - Macedonian transliteration]
Resetiraj go umot megju sekoja poena
Protresni se, raslab sekoja zglobna vrska
Vdisuvaj bavno, izdisuvaj jasno
Slednata poena pocnuva tokmu tuka

[VERSE 6 - Pashto transliteration]
Da har point tar mena khpal zehn bya jowr kra
Hagha lari waghorzawa, har ghara khlas kra
Wrusta tanafus wakhla, roshana wabasa
Bal point delta pileyzi

[CHORUS]
POINT - PIKE - POEN - RESET
RESET - BREATHE - HOLD YOUR LINE
THE POINT IS YOURS - EVERY TIME
FRESH START - EVERY SINGLE POINT

[BRIDGE - spoken]
(coach voice)
Wolof. Albanian. Burmese. Macedonian. Pashto.
Every player knows this feeling.
The last point is gone.
This one is yours.

[FINAL CHORUS]
POINT - PIKE - POEN - RESET
RESET - BREATHE - HOLD YOUR LINE
THE POINT IS YOURS - EVERY TIME
FRESH START - EVERY SINGLE POINT
EVERY LANGUAGE - ONE RESET
THE POINT IS YOURS - EVERY TIME

[OUTRO]
Every language. Every court.
The point is yours.
